reviews.title: SSD storage for a reasonable price.
reviews.comment: 2TB storage, using the industry standard where 1000 bytes equals 1KB. I'm using the memory in an external housing to backup my computer. Speed is fast enough. I haven't formally benchmarked them. At the time of purchase, there were restrictions on how many you could buy at the price I paid or I would have bought at least one more. Fit and finish seemed fine. They installed in the housing I'm using easily and worked right away.
